The five most recent presidents of the United States and their ages at the start of their presidency (as of their inauguration dates) are:

1. **Joe Biden** (46th president) - **78 years, 61 days** (inaugurated January 20, 2021)  
2. **Donald Trump** (45th president) - **70 years, 220 days** (inaugurated January 20, 2017)  
3. **Barack Obama** (44th president) - **47 years, 169 days** (inaugurated January 20, 2009)  
4. **George W. Bush** (43rd president) - **54 years, 198 days** (inaugurated January 20, 2001)  
5. **Bill Clinton** (42nd president) - **46 years, 154 days** (inaugurated January 20, 1993)  

These ages reflect the exact age at the time each president assumed office, as documented in the "List of presidents of the United States by age" Wikipedia article.
